invariants.rationale: Method returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata; should not be null if created via constructor.
instantTime typically encodes commit time; must be non-null for operation.
List of HoodieKeys to delete should not be null at method exit.
HoodieEngineContext should not be null for any table operation.
The list of WriteStatus within HoodieWriteMetadata should not be null after a delete.
